entities.name: Ophelia
entities.description: A human from Kenlefia in Jamuraa who survived the journey to Vacar Slab.

entities.name: Kenlefia
entities.description: Ophelia's home, whose people mete justice only on Vacar Slab.

entities.name: Vacar Slab
entities.description: A place in the desert where Kenlefia dispenses justice.

entities.name: Methos
entities.description: Ophelia's brother, who died of thirst.

entities.name: Abuser
entities.description: The prisoner escorted to Vacar Slab, who gave his name as Markus before dying.

entities.name: Spirokai
entities.description: An Akron Legionnaire who feels no pain and escorted the prisoner with Ophelia.

entities.name: Teeth
entities.description: The party's water-bearer, who fell off a cliff, later returned as a zombie and became a mummy.

entities.name: D'Bray
entities.description: The flagbearer, who died of thirst.

entities.name: Cleatin
entities.description: A Gray Ogre protector killed by a Duneclaw.

events.summary: Ophelia joined her brother escorting the prisoner called the Abuser and eight others to Vacar Slab.
events.quote: Ophelia joined her brother in escorting a prisoner they called the Abuser there, along with eight others

events.summary: Party members died one by one on the perilous journey.
events.quote: The journey was perilous, and the party members started dying sequentially.

events.summary: Ophelia's brother Methos died of thirst.
events.quote: Then Ophelia's brother Methos too died of thirst

events.summary: In a sandstorm Ophelia freed the Abuser and tried to escape, but Spirokai caught them and buried the Abuser to the neck.
events.quote: Ophelia freed the Abuser and tried to escape

events.summary: A zombified Teeth slashed Spirokai's head and, cursed with undeath, became a mummy.
events.quote: a zombified Teeth showed up and slashed Spirokai in the head with his sword

events.summary: Before dying the Abuser told Ophelia his name was Markus; Ophelia left alone, while Spirokai survived and began to claw his way out.
events.quote: Before dying, the Abuser told Ophelia his name was Markus .

relations.quote: Ophelia joined her brother in escorting a prisoner

relations.note: Wanted to bury her for betraying him.
relations.quote: He was about to do the same to Ophelia for betraying him
